## Frequently asked questions

Discover answers to some of the most-asked questions about our platform.

![](https://active-campaign.transforms.svdcdn.com/production/general/AC-Collage-1.png?w=1920&h=1920&q=80&auto=format&fit=crop&crop=focalpoint&fp-x=0.5&fp-y=0.5&dm=1758722839&s=3d8bbca5e2d932d5e196100d02bdd941)

- ### What happens if my contact list grows beyond my current plan’s limit—will I be penalized or locked out of features?







If your contact list grows beyond your current plan’s limit, ActiveCampaign makes it easy to upgrade to the next contact band or plan without penalties or losing access to features. You’ll never be locked out of your account or forced to pay unexpected fees—your investment simply scales as your business and opportunities expand.

- ### Are there any setup costs or hidden fees when starting with ActiveCampaign?







There are no setup costs or hidden fees when you start with ActiveCampaign. Every plan includes core features and support to help you launch quickly and confidently. You can get started on a trial plan right away, and move to a contract.

- ### How does ActiveCampaign help ensure you only pay for what you actually use, rather than bundling in unnecessary extras?







ActiveCampaign’s modular approach means you choose the plan and add-ons that fit your current needs, without being forced into bundles or paying for features you don’t use. As your business grows, you can add channels or advanced capabilities, ensuring your investment always matches your goals and usage.

- ### What are AI credits? Do all actions use credits?







AI credits are used when Active Intelligence completes an action outside of its core set of AI capabilities. This includes actions such as generating images, sending translated email campaigns, or leveraging advanced industry context & intelligence. Core AI capabilities include creating campaigns, automations, reports, contact import, and more. Currently, core AI capabilities are included as part of Active Intelligence and stay on even if your AI credits run out. For more information about AI Credits, please visit our [help page](https://help.activecampaign.com/hc/en-us/articles/31101726158492-AI-Credits-FAQs).

- ### Will I lose access to Active Intelligence if I run out of AI credits?







No. Active Intelligence and core AI capabilities keep working when your AI credits run out. Only advanced AI capabilities will pause until more AI credits are added. Proactive insights & recommendations automatically generated by the Active Intelligence system also may continue to run. For more information about AI Credits, please visit our [help page](https://help.activecampaign.com/hc/en-us/articles/31101726158492-AI-Credits-FAQs).

## ActiveCampaign Pricing
The ActiveCampaign **Professional plan** starts at $99/month with 1K contacts and 3 users. It adds conditional content, AB testing in automations, advanced segmentation and reporting, attribution and conversion tracking. The email send limit increases to 12 times your contact limit and you get priority support.

**Pro Pricing Tiers**

The ActiveCampaign **Enterprise plan** starts at $179 for 1,000 contacts and 5 users. The email send limit increases to 15 times your contact limit. It adds custom objects, SSO, premium segmentation and reporting.

[Get started with ActiveCampaign for free here](https://www.emailvendorselection.com/go/activecampaigntrial/)

## ActiveCampaign Add-ons & Extras
### ActiveCampaign Enhanced CRM Add-ons
The **Pipelines enhanced CRM add-on** includes ActiveCampaign’s sales CRM and automation. It costs **$68/month** and you can get it with a Plus, Professional, or Enterprise plan. It unlocks sales automation triggers and actions to automate your pipeline. Trigger automations based on deal stages, owners, and data changes. Then automatically add deals, update statuses, titles, owners, and deal scores. You also get sales reports including deal forecasts.

The **Sales engagement enhanced CRM add-on** costs $111/month. It includes everything in the Pipelines and Sales Engagement add-on, plus automated 1:1 emails, win probability, and sentiment analysis. Find out all the details about CRM and sales automation features in [our ActiveCampaign CRM review](https://www.emailvendorselection.com/activecampaign-crm/).

## Explaining ActiveCampaign pricing: Product, Plan, Contact, User, Integrations, Landing Pages, Conversions
- Plan
- Contact tier
- Add-ons
- User seats

### Plan
ActiveCampaign has 4 plans. It’s affordable to get started and you’ll pay more for advanced features, like conditional content, AB testing in automations, and conversion tracking. You’ll also get higher email send limits on Pro and Enterprise plans.

### Users

## So which ActiveCampaign pricing plan should you pick?

The Starter plan is great for email marketing automation for startups and small businesses. It costs $19/month for 1000 contacts, 1 user, chat and email support. You get email marketing automation, drag and drop email template builder, basic forms, and 150+ email templates.

Plus is best for small to midsize ecommerce and B2B businesses. It comes with bunch of ecommerce automations and integrations. Like cart abandonment emails and embedding product blocks into emails. You can create and test entire automation workflows. Landing pages, lead scoring, social media integration, and SMS unlock lead generation and multichannel campaigns.

Professional works well for scaling businesses that need advanced automations and tracking. Automation splitting, conversions, automations map, site messaging, predictive sending, and attribution are great features to create advanced automations.

## ActiveCampaign Pricing FAQ

### Is ActiveCampaign free?

Yes, [ActiveCampaign has a 14-day free trial](https://www.emailvendorselection.com/go/activecampaigntrial/).  You get the features of the [Pro plan](https://www.emailvendorselection.com/go/activecampaignprice/), 100 contacts and 100 email sends. There isn’t a free plan but if 14 days isn’t enough just contact ActiveCampaign to get an extension.

[Try ActiveCampaign for free here](https://www.emailvendorselection.com/go/activecampaigntrial/)

### Did ActiveCampaign change its pricing structure?

Yes, ActiveCampaign changed its pricing structure in January 2023 and June 2024. The 2024 ActiveCampaign pricing model moved the CRM features from the Sales plans into add-ons. They also renamed the Lite plan to Starter.

Pricing starts at $19/month for the Starter plan with 1000 contacts. [See ActiveCampaign pricing here](https://www.emailvendorselection.com/go/activecampaignprice/)

### Is ActiveCampaign the same as Mailchimp?

No, ActiveCampaign isn’t the same as Mailchimp. They are similar email marketing tools with a few key differences. Mailchimp is for newsletters and simple automations. It also has a free plan and phone support in Premium. ActiveCampaign works well for newsletters and has more powerful automation features and tracking. Read [our complete Mailchimp alternatives article](https://www.emailvendorselection.com/mailchimp-alternatives/) for more similar tools.

[Get started with ActiveCampaign for free](https://www.emailvendorselection.com/go/activecampaigntrial/)

### Can ActiveCampaign be used as a CRM?

Yes, [ActiveCampaign](https://www.emailvendorselection.com/go/activecampaign/) can be used as a CRM. All ActiveCampaign plans include a marketing CRM. If you’re looking for a sales CRM with automation, you can purchase an enhanced CRM add-on with a Plus, Professional, or Enterprise plan.

The **Pipelines enhanced CRM add-on** costs **$68/month.** It adds sales automation triggers and actions to automate your pipeline. You also get sales reports including deal forecasts.

The **Sales engagement enhanced CRM add-on** costs $111/month. It includes everything in the Pipelines add-on, plus automated 1:1 emails, win probability, and sentiment analysis.

[See ActiveCampaign pricing here](https://www.emailvendorselection.com/go/activecampaignprice/)

### Who is ActiveCampaign best for?

[ActiveCampaign Starter](https://www.emailvendorselection.com/go/activecampaignprice/) is best for startups and small businesses. It costs $19/month for 1000 contacts, 1 user, chat and email support. You get email marketing automation, drag and drop editor, basic forms, 150+ email templates, and site tracking.

Plus is best for small to midsize ecommerce and B2B businesses. It comes with bunch of ecommerce automations and integrations. Like cart abandonment emails and embedding product blocks into emails. Landing pages, lead scoring, Facebook Lead Ads and Custom Audiences, and SMS unlock lead generation, and multichannel campaigns.

[Get started with ActiveCampaign for free](https://www.emailvendorselection.com/go/activecampaigntrial/)

### How long is the ActiveCampaign free trial?

[The ActiveCampaign free trial](https://www.emailvendorselection.com/go/activecampaigntrial/) is 14 days long. You can test the features of the [Professional plan](https://www.emailvendorselection.com/go/activecampaignprice/). It comes with 100 contacts and 100 email sends. If 14 days isn’t enough just contact ActiveCampaign to get an extension.

[Try ActiveCampaign for free here](https://www.emailvendorselection.com/go/activecampaigntrial/)

### How many emails can you send with ActiveCampaign?

You can [send 100 emails in ActiveCampaign’s free trial](https://www.emailvendorselection.com/go/activecampaigntrial/). On Starter and Plus plans, the sending limit is 10 times your contact limit. So if you have a plan with 5,000 contacts, you can send 500,000 emails each month. The email send limit is 12x on the Pro plan and 15x on the Enterprise plan.

### Does ActiveCampaign have a setup cost?

No, [ActiveCampaign](https://www.emailvendorselection.com/go/activecampaign/) doesn’t have any setup or onboarding costs. You get these services for free when you buy a paid plan:

- Free digital onboarding
